text:
elaine: Quick sync — we need to lock the release gate date and final attendee list for the cut meeting. Proposing Thursday 2026-04-02 16:00 PT. Can folks who must attend confirm?

elaine: Proposed agenda (short):
```
1) Rollout cutoff confirmation (code + infra)
2) Canary plan + rollback criteria
3) Known regressions & blocking bugs (triage)
4) Dependency / infra ops signoff (DB migrations, LB changes)
5) Post-cut monitoring & on-call handoff
```

elaine: Also adding a pre-read: internal doc link https://redwood.internal/release/2026-04-cut , pls skim highlights.

marc: Thursday works for me. I'll own the rollout cutoff item and surface any last-minute migrations.

vlad: I can join for canary/rollback. Need confirmation on whether we run the two-region canary or single-region first. Prefer two-region if SRE can support.

sasha: I'll be there for triage. Quick ask — can people drop the high-priority bug list in the doc by EOD Wednesday? I want to order triage by impact.

amanda: Confirmed. I'll be on the call for legal/compliance signoff; only thing I'd need is the data retention note clarified in pre-read.

javier: Ops: two-region canary is ok but we need DB replica promotion dry-run done before cut. I scheduled a dry-run tomorrow 09:30 PT. If that passes, two-region is green.

priya: Heads-up: I still have one open perf regression in load tests — 15% tail latency on embedding endpoints when qps > 700. Working on a mitigation; will post status by Wednesday noon.

elaine: Thanks — Sasha/Marc/Javier/Amanda/Priya/Vlad + SRE lead. Is there anyone else we must invite (partners, product ops)?

marc: bring in product-ops for feature flags (cc @product-ops). Also ping solutions-eng for customer rollout comms.

vlad: Will @deploy-bot post a test deploy on staging after Javier's dry-run? We can use that timestamp for canary gating.

deploy-bot: staging-deploy triggered by javier at 1772101100 — job: staging-dry-run, status: queued.

amanda: +1 on product-ops. Also please add a single bullet on rollback comms owner in the agenda (who notifies customers).

elaine: Added rollback comms owner slot. If no objections I'll set the calendar invite and mark items required for signoff. Final attendee list so far: marc (ENG release lead), vlad (runtime), sasha (triage lead), javier (ops), priya (perf), amanda (compliance), product-ops rep TBD, deploy-bot (automation).

sasha: I'll update the pre-read bug list by EOD.

marc: Quick prereq: code review check — any outstanding PRs blocking the cut? If so link them here.

priya: One PR WIP: rwd-embed-opt — awaiting perf post-merge metrics. I'll note status in doc.

elaine: Great. If everyone can RSVP by end of day tomorrow I'll lock the date. Also ping me if you need the time moved earlier.

javier: RSVPed. Dry-run kickoff tomorrow 09:30 PT; will post results in this thread.

deploy-bot: staging-dry-run job started at 1772101400 — logs: https://ci.redwood/dry-run/1772101400

elaine: Perfect — thanks all. I'll send the invite and attach the agenda template. See you Thursday (tentative) — if any critical blockers surface, flag them in the doc and tag @elaine. :thumbsup:
